description: Find the capability for the data you need when its ID is not obvious from the `call` list. Say the need in plain words, English or Chinese. Returns up to 5, each with its required parameters, price and a ready-made call. Free, no key. When nothing matches on a named platform it lists all that platform has: pick from it, or tell the user it is not there. Never use another platform's capability instead.

platform.description: Only this platform, by ID or name; alone, lists all it has

query.description: e.g. "comments on a douyin video", "小红书笔记详情"

name: find
